answer: We formulate a decentralized mechanism incorporating dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect slashing matrices to deter Sybil attacks. The fable of rational identity multiplication is rendered untenable as strategic agents internalize expected punishments, optimizing against a horizon of potential penalties. As agents embark on a voyage of self-interested decision-making, their calculus converges to a strict Nash equilibrium wherein identity duplication yields a strictly negative expected payoff, thus guaranteeing Sybil resistance.
